name: JNTUA R23 Regulation (NEP)
description: JNTUA NEP-aligned R23 Regulation — 50 marks internal + 50 marks end semester, 5 units, outcome-based education

in_semester.name: Internal Assessment
in_semester.notes: Internal assessment includes two midterm exams (30 marks each, best of two counted) + assignments/quiz (20 marks). Practical subjects have separate internal assessment.

instructions: Answer any FIVE full questions, choosing at least ONE from each module.
Module 1: Q.1 or Q.2, Module 2: Q.3 or Q.4, Module 3: Q.5 or Q.6, Module 4: Q.7 or Q.8, Module 5: Q.9 or Q.10.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.

question_structure.description: Five modules each with an OR-pair. Each full question is 10 marks with sub-questions.
